warnings: Sample document. It contains no credentials: the remote example uses an {env:...} reference that each harness resolves at launch.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Reference filesystem MCP server launched over stdio.
servers.notes: Written to every supported harness. The working directory is dropped by Cline and Antigravity with a warning.

servers.name: github
servers.description: Remote GitHub MCP server using a bearer token from an environment reference.
servers.notes: The reference is written verbatim; set GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment that launches the harness. Alternatively store the token as a secret in this app.

servers.name: legacy-search
servers.description: Legacy SSE endpoint, targeted only at harnesses that still accept the SSE transport.
servers.notes: OpenCode does not support SSE; targeting it there would be reported as a skipped entry.
